Latin word

eō

eō, īre, iī (īvī), itum

Examples

  • Surge, amātor, ī domum.

    Up you get, lover boy, and go home.Plaut. Asin. 921b

  • C. Arrius proximus est vīcīnus, immō ille quidem jam contubernālis, quī etiam sē idcircō Rōmam īre negat ut hīc mēcum tōtōs diēs philosophētur.

    Gaius Arrius is my nearest neighbour, or rather my housemate by now: he even says he isn’t going to Rome, so that he can spend whole days here philosophising with me.Cic. Att. 2.14.2
